dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: The Lantern Rite festival is more magnificent than I ever imagined... Hm, wonder what I should check out next...

choices.text: I've released my Xiao Lantern, too.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Is that your Xiao Lantern? It's beautiful! I'm thinking of buying a few more to take back to Fontaine...

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: In any case, I hope your wishes come true.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Haha, I suppose I should say... Happy Lantern Rite to you too!
